verdict.rationale: Convex's own docs describe it as open source, and the self-hosting docs say self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend with the same code the cloud service uses. A public GitHub repository (get-convex/convex-backend) is also cited, so the source is readable. However, no evidence names the specific license or its terms, so the 'open license' part of the story is only asserted rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit license name and terms (e.g., a LICENSE file citation), confirmation that client libraries and the CLI are also open, independent corroboration of license openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.
Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses.
You can either use Docker (recommended) or a prebuilt binary to self host Convex.
